name: Ocean tuna
summary: The fish Du lịch Phú Yên says Phú Yên led the country in catching. The same office also calls it cá bò gù. Cold slices go in mustard greens. The handbook also names gỏi bao tử and cá ngừ cuốn cải xanh. The eye is its own plate. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s tuna article and its 6 October 2024 cẩm nang describe the fish. Cục Du lịch Quốc gia Việt Nam names cá on the provincial plate.
texture: Thin cold slices, rolled in mustard greens. The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang names cá ngừ cuốn cải xanh among the plates people ask for.
howToEat: Roll the thin slices in mustard greens with wasabi, chilli sauce, soy, herbs, green banana, and ginger. That is the tuna article’s plate.
The 6 October 2024 cẩm nang also names gỏi bao tử. A method for that plate was not printed. Check on arrival.

where: Lê Duẩn and bờ kè Bạch Đằng are where the 6 October 2024 cẩm nang sends you for the tuna. The night article adds the Điện Biên Phủ and Lê Duẩn corner. Hours are Check on arrival.
